action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: I couldn't find any past reservations for Dana Lee, so I can't tell which New York hotel is "Dana's usual." Available for 11/12–11/14 (2 nights): Midtown Lodge (H1, $378 total), Harbor Inn (H2, $478 total), Plaza Grand (H3, $918 total). Which one is Dana's usual hotel? (The cheapest nonstop flight is F100 at $289. Note: with Plaza Grand the trip total would be $1,207, which is over $1000 and needs manager approval.)
